lines.t: Holidays, empty hands, searching faces in the night
Pages of hope and chains, dirty water and shards of light
A voice inside me roars, can your heart be unbound?
Come out broken suns, there's love to be found
Darkness thickens, but I hummed before a healing flame
Everything now is washed away when you call my name
I am undone by love that I can't erase
You tore down every wall, you invaded every space
Whispering, you're never alone, not for one day
Still you're the fire that drives my old ghosts away
Break my bonds, burn my shame, refiners, fire, set me ablaze
Every scar now sings your name, I'm a flame that can't be broken, I am changed
Strike the strings of my heart till my soul's awake
Take this stone, let it break
Breathe your fire till the ashes dance away
I walked through deserts, made my mind mistakes
Tasted bitterness, ran from the mirror's face
You said, let your light shine, don't hide what's true
Be steadfast, let every veil fall and meet with you
I've been a prodigal, lost in this world's broken soul
I found grace by the fire that burned all the night long
Night comes, crashing down on vivid dreams
Flood of tears, pure gold, dried by suffering
Be shown in love, let go, let it be
At the sound of your voice, I am finally free
Break my bones, burn my shame
Refiner's fire set me ablaze
Every scar now sings your name
I'm a flame that can't be broken
I am changed
Let your love rush in
Let my wounds be turned
All my sorrow becomes the lesson I've learned
A flame that can't be broken
Still burning for you
Let your love rush in
Let my wounds be turned
All my sorrow becomes a lesson I've learned
A flame that can't be broken
Still burning for you
